detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Support Your Crazy Lady (The Developer) and Get Cool Gifts! 

If you are enjoying Cat Chess, want to help us out and also get cool skins and customization options for your cats and games, this one is for you. It directly contributes to the game’s developments and, as a small thank you, unlocks special and unique looks:

  • A New, Exclusive FULL CATS SET of mutant cats!

  • 1 New mutant cats station

  • 1 New mutant chess board

  • a music pack

This will be also shown to other players so you can show off your special cats to friends you play against! 

Note: getting this DLC is a GREAT way to support the developer and we appreciate it a lot!
